author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Mangmi Air Y handhelds are releasing in a saturated market - we have a ton of vertical devices to choose from. But surprisingly, both the Air Y (Snapdragon 662) and Air Y Pro (Snapdragon 865) fill a gap in the handheld niche with their competitive price and performance.

More info: https://tinyurl.com/RGC-AirY

These were review units sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.

Check out my weekly newsletter: http://news.retrogamecorps.com/
